heterogeneity_flagged: TRADE_WAR — UNMAPPED. Its named mechanism (canonical dACC[Hyper] 'conflict/error monitor — priors-too-strong' + summary 'Retaliatory tariffs, sanctions, and trade restrictions') is an ADVERSARIAL strategic-conflict failure (agent-vs-agent retaliation) compounded by an aberrant-precision / over-weighted-prior belief pathology. None of the 9 Part XIV classes (all E/I-dynamics archetypes: excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation) expresses adversarial retaliation or a 'priors-too-strong' prediction-weighting failure. Marked UNMAPPED rather than force-fit. THIS IS THE KEY FINDING: Trade contains a failure archetype (adversarial conflict) the neuro-substrate taxonomy cannot represent — the Trade analog of Finance's FRAUD_SCANDAL (information-integrity), but a DIFFERENT out-of-taxonomy archetype (adversarial rather than deception).

GATING DOMINANCE — FOUR of the five Trade issues collapse onto the SAME Part XIV class (GATING_FAILURE), because logistics IS routing: SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE and PORT_BLOCKADE are the routing gate stuck CLOSED (starvation), SHIPPING_CRISIS is the SAME node (THAL) stuck OPEN (flood), and CUSTOMS_DISRUPTION is the inhibitory brake clamped shut (over-grip -> starvation of flow). Where Finance spread across SEIZURE / GATING_FAILURE / DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME / DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS, Trade concentrates on gating. Recorded per issue.

SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE — classed on its NODE cue (THAL[Hypo] 'stuck-closed=starvation' -> GATING_FAILURE); its SUMMARY ('Cascading failures across interconnected logistics systems') points at a DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS network-cascade flavor. Divergence between node cue and summary recorded, not resolved by guessing.

CUSTOMS_DISRUPTION — the named mechanism is EXCESS inhibition (vmPFC 'over-grip=flatness'), the mirror pole of DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME; there is no dedicated over-inhibition class among the 9, so it is classed by its downstream signature (flow halted -> starvation) as GATING_FAILURE. The excess-inhibition mechanism is flagged.

SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE, PORT_BLOCKADE, SHIPPING_CRISIS — their CANONICAL single-node circuits (THAL alone) are a bare non-regulatory gating node that would FAIL the incomplete-circuit test in isolation. The _authored multi-node circuits supply the regulatory partner, so the test passes on _authored. Observation recorded per issue.
_meta.honesty_note: Mechanisms, failure-mode classes, parameters, and references below are verbatim-grounded in the source document. Per-node / per-edge Trade-specific assignments the document gives no basis for (which edge is which inhibitory motif, which oscillatory band, which neuromodulator, which predictive direction) are NOT guessed here; only the two operations the source document directly supports are performed: (1) classify each authored issue against the Part XIV failure taxonomy where the issue's own text names a matching mechanism, and (2) run the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Inhibition tracks excitation on a millisecond timescale; balance sets gain, dynamic range, timing precision, and stability. Loss of inhibition -> runaway (seizure); excess -> silence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Any faithful mapping must have inhibition/brakes that SCALE WITH DRIVE.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Four inhibitory motifs
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: feedforward (narrow temporal window / coincidence), feedback/recurrent (self-limiting, gain control, stability), lateral (contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening), disinhibition (inhibiting an inhibitor = permissive gating/selection).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: All four are reused at every scale; their absence breaks the fractal.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Oscillations & communication-through-coherence
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Rhythms create periodic windows of excitability; groups that oscillate coherently open input/output windows at the same time and communicate; incoherent groups are functionally disconnected. Bands: delta 1-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-12, beta 13-30, gamma 30-80+ Hz.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Coherence = a dynamic routing/connection switch. There is an OPTIMAL coupling band; too-strong and too-weak coupling both fail.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Thalamocortical gating
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Thalamus + TRN gate what reaches cortex; tonic (faithful relay) vs burst (detection/alerting) modes under corticothalamic top-down control.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Gating must occur AT THE RIGHT STAGE - filter too early (before the circuit that needs the signal) and you lose information you cannot recover.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Predictive coding / prediction error
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hierarchical generative machine: top-down predictions descend, bottom-up prediction ERRORS ascend, only the mismatch propagates upward. Laminar correlate: forward = error, backward = prediction.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: 'Prediction error drives update' must also GENERATE predictions at the mapped scale, not merely react.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Plasticity / learning rules
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hebbian (correlated -> strengthen); STDP (pre-before-post ~+10 ms -> LTP, post-before-pre -> LTD; dopamine extends LTP window to ~+30 ms); LTP/LTD (NMDA/Ca2+); homeostatic scaling (global normalization keeping drive in range so Hebbian learning does not run away); metaplasticity (threshold for change adapts).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A stabilizing counter-process (homeostatic scaling) MUST counter positive-feedback Hebbian learning, or the system runs away.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Neuromodulation & gain
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Diffuse systems (DA, NE, 5-HT, ACh) carry no detailed content; they set global regime - gain, signal-to-noise, exploration/exploitation, learning rate, arousal. A small modulatory signal reconfigures the whole network's operating point.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A small broadcast signal must be able to rescale the whole system's operating point (one-to-many, multiplicative).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Population & attractor dynamics
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Information lives in distributed population activity, not single cells; sparse coding is efficient/separable; attractor dynamics implement stable states and transitions. Over-gating, over-synchrony, or lost inhibition suppress emergence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Emergence requires distributed, sparse, inhibition-balanced activity; do not concentrate all state in one node.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Sleep, homeostasis & offline processing
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Sleep down-scales synapses globally while consolidating select memories, and drives glymphatic clearance of waste.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A mandatory OFFLINE maintenance/reset phase - a system with no downtime accumulates damage.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Signal termination / clearance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Reuptake, enzymatic degradation, and diffusion bound signal persistence; termination is as important as release and prevents excitotoxic accumulation.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Clearance/termination must bound signal persistence; a signal that isn't cleared becomes toxic (see failure mode EXCITOTOXICITY).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Refractoriness / dead-time rate limiter
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Absolute refractory period (~1-2 ms) after an action prevents a second action; enforces one-way propagation and caps maximum firing rate.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A built-in rate limiter / dead-time after action must exist to cap throughput and enforce directionality.

inhibitory_motifs_catalog.definition: Input excites both a target and an interneuron that inhibits the target -> narrow temporal window (coincidence-detection, AND within a time window).
Output feeds back through interneurons -> self-limiting, gain control, stability.
Active units suppress neighbors -> contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening.
Inhibiting an inhibitor -> permissive gating / selection.

failure_modes.definition: E/I balance failure: runaway recurrent excitation when inhibition is insufficient. Archetypal no-brakes -> runaway.
Excessive drive with failed termination/clearance -> overload -> death of the unit.
A slow wave of depolarization then silence; homeostatic overwhelm.
Thalamocortical/TRN gating breakdown: too little filtering -> flooding, or mis-timed gating -> wrong information passed; gate stuck closed -> starvation.
Losing the inhibitor releases pathological activity (loss of the stop/brake).
Over-coupling (hypersynchrony) or under-coupling; both degrade communication.
Aggregation + failed clearance + network collapse; maintenance failure compounding over time.
Losing input disables not just the lesioned node but distant connected regions. THE NETWORK, NOT THE NODE, IS THE UNIT OF FAILURE; failures propagate across the graph.

A circuit built without its regulatory partner is intrinsically dysfunctional (fear acquisition without extinction; excitation without matched inhibition; feedback without the sensor). THE DIRECT DIAGNOSTIC FOR A BROKEN FRACTAL MAPPING: if the mapping omits the inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm, it is lesioned in the same way a brain is.

issue_failure_class_map._basis: GROUNDED: each mapping uses the Trade issue's OWN text (canonical circuit detail and/or summary, quoted in trade_text) plus the document's Part XIV named class. No new class was invented. Where the issue text names a mechanism with no analog among the 9 classes, it is marked UNMAPPED rather than force-fit.

SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE.trade_text: canonical circuit THAL[Hypo]: "gating relay / routing — stuck-closed=starvation"; summary: "Cascading failures across interconnected logistics systems — production halted, shelves empty, critical goods unavailable"
SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE.reasoning: The named mechanism is a ROUTING GATE stuck closed. A gate stuck closed producing downstream starvation (production halted, shelves empty) is the GATING_FAILURE archetype (gate stuck closed -> starvation), matching Energy's/Finance's gating-relay stuck-closed mapping. The _authored circuit confirms starvation: HIPP 'buffer stock exhausted', M1 'trucking paralyzed', S1 'last-mile failing'.
SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE.note: The SUMMARY ('Cascading failures across interconnected logistics systems') carries a secondary DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS network-cascade flavor. Classed on the primary NODE cue (gate stuck-closed = the resolved motif M4), which is the dominant mechanism named; the node-vs-summary divergence is flagged, not resolved by guessing.

PORT_BLOCKADE.trade_text: canonical circuit THAL[Hypo]: "gating relay / routing — stuck-closed=starvation"; summary: "Major port operations halted by congestion, labor action, geopolitical closure, or infrastructure failure"
PORT_BLOCKADE.reasoning: Ports are the routing gate of trade; a blockade is that gate stuck closed. 'Port operations halted' + the _authored THAL 'gridlocked, vessel queue extending to weeks' = throughput gated shut -> downstream starvation. Same GATING_FAILURE (gate stuck closed -> starvation) as SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE, on the same node (THAL).
PORT_BLOCKADE.note: The _authored THAL direction is 'Hyper-congested' (gridlock) while the canonical cue is 'Hypo / stuck-closed'; both describe the same functional outcome — no cargo passes the gate. Classed by the canonical stuck-closed cue and the 'halted' summary.

SHIPPING_CRISIS.trade_text: canonical circuit THAL[Hyper]: "gating relay / routing — stuck-open=flood"; summary: "Maritime disruption from piracy, canal closure, extreme weather, or vessel shortage causing global freight emergency"
SHIPPING_CRISIS.reasoning: The named mechanism is explicitly the gate stuck OPEN (flood), the other GATING_FAILURE subtype ('too little filtering -> flooding'). Diverted lanes and out-of-sequence arrivals flood the downstream network with mis-timed traffic. The _authored circuit shows the flood being shunted: FEF 'air freight demand surging 3-5x', THAL 'port schedules shattered, berth allocation chaotic'.
SHIPPING_CRISIS.note: STRONGEST intra-domain contrast: SHIPPING_CRISIS is the SAME node (THAL) as SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE / PORT_BLOCKADE but the OPPOSITE gate direction — stuck-open (flood) vs stuck-closed (starvation). Both are GATING_FAILURE, different subtypes; this is exactly the failureModes pair canonical-nodes lists for THAL ('stuck-open=flood / stuck-closed=starvation').

CUSTOMS_DISRUPTION.trade_text: canonical circuit vmPFC[Hyper]: "top-down inhibitory brake — over-grip=flatness"; summary: "Border processing failures from regulatory changes, system outages, or inspection backlogs halting cross-border flow"
CUSTOMS_DISRUPTION.reasoning: The named mechanism is the top-down INHIBITORY BRAKE with EXCESS grip ('over-grip=flatness'). Excess inhibition clamps the customs gate shut, halting cross-border flow -> downstream starvation. Classed by that downstream signature (flow halted / starved) as GATING_FAILURE, the same outcome archetype as the other three routing failures.
CUSTOMS_DISRUPTION.note: MECHANISM DIVERGENCE FLAGGED: the driver here is EXCESS inhibition (over-grip), the MIRROR POLE of DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME (which is loss of the brake). The 9 Part XIV classes contain no dedicated 'over-inhibition -> silence' archetype (EI_BALANCE names 'excess -> silence' as a mechanism, but XIV has no class for it), so it is classed by its downstream starvation outcome, not force-fit to DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME. This is the one grounded issue whose MECHANISM is not a clean member of the 9 even though its OUTCOME is.

TRADE_WAR.reason: Issue text names a mechanism with NO analog among the 9 Part XIV classes.
TRADE_WAR.trade_text: canonical circuit dACC[Hyper]: "conflict/error monitor — priors-too-strong"; summary: "Retaliatory tariffs, sanctions, and trade restrictions disrupting established commercial relationships"
TRADE_WAR.reasoning: A trade war is an ADVERSARIAL strategic-conflict process: two agents (states) locked in tit-for-tat retaliation (tariff -> retaliation -> more tariff). Overlaid, the node cue 'conflict/error monitor — priors-too-strong' names an aberrant-precision / over-weighted-prior belief pathology (the monitor is locked into a hostile prior and will not update). Neither adversarial retaliation nor over-weighted-prior belief is expressible by the 9 Part XIV classes, which are all dynamical-failure archetypes (excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation). Forcing it into any of the 9 (e.g. SEIZURE for 'escalation' or DISINHIBITION for 'lost diplomatic brake') would be a guess that discards the adversarial and belief-weighting content. Marked UNMAPPED per discipline.
TRADE_WAR.note: This is the KEY HETEROGENEITY FINDING for Trade, and the analog of Finance's FRAUD_SCANDAL — but a DIFFERENT out-of-taxonomy archetype: Finance's was information-integrity / deception; Trade's is ADVERSARIAL strategic conflict. Both are non-dynamical failure archetypes the E/I neuro-substrate taxonomy structurally cannot represent.

incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._test: Part XIV: does each issue's authored circuit contain a regulatory/inhibitory/feedback partner from the REGULATORY_NODES set in energy-neuro-substrate.js (vmPFC, dlPFC, OFC, STN, GP, HIPP, HYPO, dACC, CBLM)? Run against trade.json _authored circuits, matching the JS validateIncompleteCircuit() behavior (uses _authored node list, falling back to circuits).
incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._verdict_summary: PASS (5/5). Every authored circuit includes at least one regulatory/feedback node; none is a bare excitatory/gating driver without its brake. NOTE: three issues (SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE, PORT_BLOCKADE, SHIPPING_CRISIS) have CANONICAL single-node circuits (THAL alone) that are a bare non-regulatory gating node and WOULD fail the test in isolation; the _authored multi-node circuits supply the regulatory partner. Two issues (TRADE_WAR canonical dACC, CUSTOMS_DISRUPTION canonical vmPFC) have canonical single nodes that are themselves regulatory, so they pass even canonical-only.

SUPPLY_CHAIN_COLLAPSE.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is THAL[Hypo] alone (gating relay, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT if run canonical-only; _authored supplies dlPFC (executive) + HIPP (HPA/memory feedback).

PORT_BLOCKADE.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is THAL[Hypo] alone (gating relay, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT if run canonical-only; _authored supplies HIPP + CBLM (forward-model error-correction).

TRADE_WAR.observation: Circuit is complete (four regulatory partners present), yet the issue is UNMAPPED in the failure-class map: a circuit can be structurally complete under the incomplete-circuit test and still express a failure archetype (adversarial conflict) outside the 9-class taxonomy. The two diagnostics are independent — same pattern as Finance FRAUD_SCANDAL.

SHIPPING_CRISIS.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is THAL[Hyper] alone (gating relay, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT if run canonical-only; _authored supplies HYPO (homeostatic set-point) + dlPFC.

CUSTOMS_DISRUPTION.observation: Canonical single node is vmPFC[Hyper] (top-down inhibitory brake), itself a REGULATORY_NODE -> passes even canonical-only; _authored adds OFC valuation.

parameter_table._note: Part XV, verbatim. Quantitative substrate for scale-rescaling. Confidence + anchor preserved.

rows.parameter: Gut serotonin fraction of body total

parameter_table.ratio_preservation_rule: When mapping any neural time constant to a domain equivalent, hold the RATIOS between constants fixed, not just individual values. The ~1000x gap between AP duration (~1 ms) and slow neuromodulatory/hormonal feedback (~seconds-minutes) is the 'fast signal vs slow modulation' invariant; the Trade mapping must preserve an analogous fast-action / slow-governance separation (e.g. a truck dispatch vs a renegotiated trade treaty), or the fractal is cosmetic, not structural.
